headline: Wordle clone for vinyl records goes viral among collectors
summary: A daily browser game called Crate Drop asks players to identify an album by clues — tracklist length, release year, label, country. Players get six guesses with green/yellow/grey grid feedback after each guess. The site reports a 64% solve rate and 20,000 daily players since launch two weeks ago. The format borrows directly from earlier Wordle imitators that spawned during the 2022 craze.
